title: Checking In at a Hotel
meta: B2 · 约 280 词 · 场景：酒店入住与客房问题

lines.en: Good evening, and welcome. Are you checking in?
lines.zh: 晚上好，欢迎光临。您是要办入住吗？

lines.en: Yes, I have a __reservation under the name__ Lee.
lines.zh: 是的，我用 Lee 这个名字订了房。

lines.en: Let me pull that up. A king room for three nights, checking out on Sunday?
lines.zh: 我查一下。一间大床房，住三晚，周日退房，对吗？

lines.en: **That's right. Is it possible to get a room on a higher floor, away from the elevator?**
lines.zh: 对。有没有可能给我一间高楼层、离电梯远一点的房间？

lines.en: Let me check. Yes, I can put you on the eighteenth floor with a city view.
lines.zh: 我看看。可以，我给您安排在十八楼，城景房。

lines.en: May I have your passport and a credit card for ==incidentals==?
lines.zh: 麻烦出示一下护照，再给一张信用卡用于杂费预授权。

lines.en: Sure. How much is the ==deposit==?
lines.zh: 好的。押金是多少？

lines.en: It's one hundred dollars per night, and it's released when you check out.
lines.zh: 每晚一百元，退房时会解冻。

lines.en: Got it. Is breakfast ==included==, and what time does it start?
lines.zh: 明白。含早餐吗？几点开始？

lines.en: Yes, it's included. It's served from six thirty to ten thirty on the second floor.
lines.zh: 含的。早餐在二楼，六点半到十点半。

lines.en: And could I __get a late checkout__ on Sunday? My flight isn't until the evening.
lines.zh: 另外周日能晚点退房吗？我的航班是晚上的。

lines.en: I can give you until one o'clock __at no extra charge__.
lines.zh: 我可以给您延到一点，不额外收费。

lines.en: One o'clock works. Thanks so much.
lines.zh: 一点可以。太感谢了。

lines.en: Hi, this is Mr. Lee in room eighteen twelve. The air conditioning isn't working, and the room is quite warm.
lines.zh: 你好，我是一八一二房间的 Lee。空调坏了，房间里挺热的。

lines.en: I'm so sorry about that. I'll __send someone up__ right away to take a look.
lines.zh: 非常抱歉。我马上派人上去看看。

lines.en: **Thanks. If it can't be fixed tonight, would it be possible to move to another room?**
lines.zh: 谢谢。如果今晚修不好，能不能换个房间？

lines.en: Of course. If the ==technician== can't fix it in fifteen minutes, we'll ==upgrade== you to a suite on the same floor.
lines.zh: 当然可以。如果维修师傅十五分钟内修不好，我们就给您升级到同一层的套房。

lines.en: That would be great. Could you also send up two extra towels?
lines.zh: 那太好了。能再送两条毛巾上来吗？

lines.en: No problem. And to __make up for__ the trouble, we'll send up a ==complimentary== fruit plate.
lines.zh: 没问题。为了弥补给您带来的不便，我们会再送一份免费的水果拼盘。

lines.en: That's very kind. **Thanks for sorting this out so quickly.**
lines.zh: 你们太客气了。谢谢这么快就帮我解决。

lines.en: My pleasure, Mr. Lee. Enjoy the rest of your evening.
lines.zh: 不客气，Lee 先生。祝您晚上愉快。

gist.q: 「你」对房间提了什么要求？前台怎么安排的？
gist.a: 要高楼层、离电梯远的房间；前台安排在十八楼的城景房。

gist.q: 押金和延迟退房的规则分别是什么？
gist.a: 押金每晚一百元，退房时解冻；可以免费延迟退房到下午一点。

gist.q: 空调坏了，酒店给出的解决方案是什么？
gist.a: 马上派维修师傅；十五分钟修不好就升级到同层套房，并免费送水果拼盘。

prompts.q: 入住时发现订的是两张单人床，你想换成一张大床。用 30 秒跟前台沟通，礼貌但明确。
prompts.ref: Hi, sorry to bother you. I just got to my room, and it has two single beds, but I booked a king room. Is it possible to switch to a king tonight? If none are free, could you move me tomorrow morning? I'm happy to pack my things and wait in the lobby.
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，不好意思打扰一下。我刚进房间，发现是两张单人床，但我订的是大床房。今晚能换成大床吗？如果没有空房了，明天早上帮我换可以吗？我可以先收拾好东西在大堂等。

prompts.q: 隔壁房间半夜很吵，你打电话给前台。说清房号、问题，并提出你希望的处理方式。
prompts.ref: Hi, this is room eighteen twelve. I'm sorry to call so late, but the room next door has been really loud for about an hour, and I have an early flight. Could someone ask them to keep it down? If that doesn't work, I'd like to move to a quieter room.
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我是一八一二房间。抱歉这么晚打电话，隔壁房间已经吵了快一个小时了，我明天一早还要赶飞机。能不能请人去提醒他们小声一点？如果不管用，我想换一间安静点的房间。
